name: AITWIRE API
description:
The AITWIRE API enables developers to programmatically manage entities, run scans, query authority graphs, monitor drift, track attribution, and manage webhooks and API keys.

## Authentication
All API requests require a Bearer token or X-API-Key header with an `atwk_*` API key.

## Base URL
`https://api.aitwire.com/v1/`

## Rate Limits
- Standard: 60 req/min, 1,000 calls/mo included
- Pro: 300 req/min, 50,000 calls/mo included
- AITWIRE AI: 1,000 req/min, contract-based
